title: The SpongeBob Movie: Search for SquarePants

direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale is very traditional for SpongeBob SquarePants; The direction on a microscale is very traditional for SpongeBob; The storytelling is very silly and cute, like SpongeBob

performance.comments: The moment when I thought there wasn't enough Sandy Cheeks in this movie, there she walks into my life
Not that much Plankton in this movie :()
Geniunely didn't even know it was her, hats off to you Regina Hall
Not the original Flying Dutchman voice, but he's Mark Hamill so I'll allow it

story.comments: The concept is cute and fun, like SpongeBob; The plot structure is very linear and meant for fans of SpongeBob; Character writing is typical of SpongeBob

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is very silly and goofy, like SpongeBob; The humor is very silly, like SpongeBob; The symbolism is cute and meant for children, like SpongeBob; The foreshadowing is pretty typical for a kids' movie because it is, after all, SpongeBob

soundtrack.comments: The song choice is so silly and goofy that it helps the vibe they are going for

animation.comments: While I am not a big fan of SpongeBob using 3D-style animation, I thought this movie was well-animated and brought out a dimension of SpongeBob that was previously unseen

review.pacing: The pacing is about right given the runtime, as the movie effectively uses its short duration
review.climax: The climax is cute and fun, like SpongeBob
review.tone: The tone is very silly and goofy, like SpongeBob
review.overall: Overall, this movie is just so silly and goofy that it is very fun to watch if you play along with it; However, no matter how hard it tries, it will never be 'The SpongeBob SquarePants Movie (2004)'
